description: A snowy city side street at dusk, painted in oils. A lit storefront window on the left has the letters FOLK CITY and candles. Brick tenements with fire escapes line the right, with a VW van and 1950s-60s cars parked. A worn guitar case leans against a black lamppost in the foreground, with footprints in the snow. No people, no frame.
reason: The coffeehouse window has the words FOLK CITY painted on it. Repaint the window with no lettering.
